profile.headline: Software Developer for Amazon Fire TV

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical Lead for software development of Notebook Player, an application for SMART's Interactive Flat Panels (IFP) running a customized Android OS. App brought together proprietary Notebook file format parsing, native whiteboard functionality, real time collaboration with mobile companion app, HTML utility controls, classroom management and Bing content search, cross-app communication and proprietary REST service integration.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
May 2012 - Feb 2015
Develop software that exposes and configures data collection solutions like enterprise barcode scanning on Android. Current architect of Android data collection service. Current gatekeeper for team source code responsible for deciding what is and isn't acceptable for merging. Software is developed with Java and C++ and comprises an Android settings app and an Android service providing a programming interface through intents, AIDL, and JSON-RPC over HTTP for web applications.

January 2010 - May 2012
Developed automated tests for imaging solutions on Windows and Windows Mobile. Maintained and develop test automation infrastructure. Reported and verified bugs. Tests developed in C# ran on a host computer displaying images for the device under test to decode. Device under test was controlled through RAPI for Windows Mobile computers and through TCP/IP for Windows computers. Services written in C++ on Windows Mobile and C# on Windows ran on the device and accepted commands. This allowed the same tests to run on many different platforms. Developed code generator to consume device-side .NET DLLs and produce proxy types with full support for exceptions, callbacks, and foreach and using statements drastically reducing the effort required to create tests for new features. Introduced Model Based Testing and developed first model based tests at Intermec. Setup automated test infrastructure for Android using LAVA from Linaro. Created several LAVA extensions written in Python and using the Django web framework for enabling Android Junit tests, gtest C++ unit tests, LDAP authentication, and integration with Jenkins for Continuous Integration.

positions.title: SDET
positions.description: Owned quality assurance of the SQL Server Reporting Services and Visual Studios Report Viewer controls. Developed automated UI tests with C# that exercised the Viewer Control in its many forms as WinForms, WebForms, and a Sharepoint WebPart. Developed API tests for the Viewer Controls. Logged discovered bugs. Reproduced reported bugs. Verified fixes for bugs. Helped answer customer questions on MSDN Forums. Triaged incoming bugs to determine if they were valid, who the owner should be, what the priority should be and by when it should be fixed.  Signed off on the quality of the Report Viewer for product releases and hotfixes for both SQL Server and Visual Studios. This required satisfying the sometimes very different processes and requirements of both Visual Studios and SQL Server.

positions.title: Software Test Intern
positions.description: Developed automated remote Data Collections testing software as part of a team. This involved a custom C# test driver that used RAPI run C++ tests on Windows Mobile barcode scanners. Maintained, debugged, and updated software builds. Identified bugs and submitted them to ClearQuest and/or tracked down their sources. Contributed to the design and planning of future software versions.
